امتنعا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَنَعَا (imtanaʕā) /im.ta.na.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# اُمْتُنِعَا (umtuniʕā) /um.tu.ni.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# اِمْتَنِعَا (imtaniʕā) /im.ta.ni.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
